notes.title: Dinosaur Park - Primeval Zoo the old-fashioned way
notes.notes:
Some may like it modern, but the Dinosaur Park celebrates Christmas in a traditional and classic way.
Your Dinosaur Park is getting cozy and celebrating a Christmas of the most classical kind. During the winter event, you'll set up Christmas decorations on your site.

You'll have the choice of the Christmas bank, the big pile of gifts, and the Christmas tree, among others. Each decoration will release snowflakes at regular intervals.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285822/406d9a517357f3a92d2d7c49a0404b82b48c2805.jpg[/img]

Your goal is to collect these snowflakes and exchange them for your rewards. Exclusive decorations await you, such as the Santa-Rex balloon, plenty of chests, and a completely new animal.

This new addition is the Ornitholestes, a theropod dinosaur that lived around 150 million years ago during the Late Jurassic period. During the event, you can acquire two specimens of it that would like to move into a grass enclosure in the game.

The winter event runs until December 19th at 12 p.m. Afterwards, you'll have until January 2nd, also at 12 p.m., to collect your rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285822/fd89805af38de23fc8cf3c7994cfa07763dc42a6.jpg[/img]

If you're up for more dinos, now you'll get the Nasutoceratops as a bonus when you acquire at least 100 ammonites. With a purchase of 200 ammonites or more, you'll get two specimens as a bonus.

We wish you lots of fun during the winter event at Dinosaur Park – Primeval Zoo.

notes.title: A Blast from the Past: Explore the Jurassic!
notes.notes:
Players level 30 and up can now purchase a Transport Station and unlock the brand-new Jurassic Zoo region for 100 Ammonites!

The Jurassic Zoo is a secondary zoo with lots of space for more animals and decorations! It comes with some exciting features!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285822/ec12c2dcb66e74630a480c373acfd758ef46a096.jpg[/img]

The Jurassic Zoo comes with its own line-up of feature buildings (staff building, breeding center, visitor information) with a Jurassic twist. This means, you can also effectively get more breeding slots!

All animals and decorations from the main zoo can also be placed in the Jurassic Zoo, but of course, there are also plenty of new decorations to fit the flora and fauna of the Jurassic era (you can recognize region-exclusive items by the darker Jurassic background).

Animals that lived during the Jurassic will grant 50% more experience and have a 50% higher base breeding chance* when kept in the Jurassic Zoo.

notes.title: Halloween Event
notes.notes:
From now until October 31st at 11:59 am CET, you'll find the seasonal event section of the shop stocked with spooky decorations for Halloween - don't get lost following the wisps!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285822/f60fea8bd80f8d6a637d64f0aff96a8350fb058f.jpg[/img]

Your Halloween decorations will supply you with Pumpkins regularly, which can be collected by tapping on the pins over them. Collect and redeem these for a brand-new animal for your zoo: Bajadasaurus, and spooky new Holemesina-variant, the Gray Holmesina!

Don't have enough Pumpkins? No need to panic! You can always purchase more in the event window for Ammonites. Just make sure to redeem your Pumpkins for prizes before November 7!

We've also added last year's Halloween decorations and prize animal to the club section of the shop!

Happy haunting!
